scenes.title: Where and when
narration: The dance is practiced in the coastal districts of Odisha, including Cuttack, Jajapur, Jagatsinghpur, Puri, Khurda, Bhadrak, Baleswar, Dhenkanal, and Angul.
It is traditionally performed by young boys of the Gauda or Gopal castes.

scenes.title: When it is danced
narration: The dance is performed during Dola Purnima (Holi) and is dedicated to Krishna and his consort Radha.
Today it is a living tradition.
